about: A saved Anthropic API key (an invented placeholder, saved through PUT /api/config), then Settings > Models > API keys > AI providers > Remove. The browser's own confirm box cannot be drawn by headless Chrome, so window.confirm is replaced in the page by a stub that records the question and answers Cancel: on main the shot shows the page with no dialog of the app's (the question went to the browser's box), on this branch the app's own confirm.

steps.eval: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/config', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ anthropic: { key: 'sk-ant-api03-QAexampleOnly0000000000000000' } }) }); return r.status; })()
(() => { window.__asked = []; window.confirm = (question) => { window.__asked.push(String(question)); return false; }; return true; })()
